mission: Own provider requests, reservations and terminal receipts while preventing raw provider escape.
runtimeTopology: Inference control is the owner-local scheduler and settlement authority. It creates durable request, reservation, assignment, cancellation and settlement transitions; workers cannot refund or rewrite them.
physicalState: A bounded append journal is fsync'd before in-memory publication and replayed on reopen. Records bind request, principal, model, payload, reservation, worker generation, usage and revision.
linearization: Submit/reserve/assign/cancel/settle each linearize at an appended, flushed and sync_data journal event. Expected revision and exact identity prevent conflicting replay.
recovery: Corrupt or out-of-order journal events fail reopen. Cancellation racing completion records one settlement; unknown consumption remains indeterminate instead of being refunded.
security: No raw provider escape is allowed. Request, reservation, worker, model, payload, token limit and authority epoch must match before dispatch or settlement.
capacity: Records <=16384, tokens <=1000000, configured shard queue <=4096. Quota, queue age, cancellation latency and unsettled reservation age are bounded metrics.
terminalObserver: Inference control accepts only authenticated worker/provider observations matching the exact assignment. The actual provider/device remains the external terminal observer.
externalEvidenceGaps: deployed worker discovery, quota owner and provider/device observation
target-host persistence path, performance and recovery qualification
